column6: The back-translation changes 'foundational' to 'essential' and 'ability' to 'abilities', which alters the specific theological categories being referenced. This could lead to different interpretations of God's nature and attributes.
column7: The attributes are grouped into relational, moral, foundational, ability categories. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Foundational attributes describe His essential nature of being.
column8: Attributes are divided into categories: relational, moral, essential, and abilities. Relational attributes describe how we personally experience God. Moral attributes describe His character. Essential attributes describe His intrinsic nature of being.
